verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance case-management SaaS, so a natural-language command interface is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents only APIs, UI click workflows, and generic automation. The homepage line about moving 'cases between agents and your team' shows automation, but it does not show that users can operate the product through natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
